description: Offline-first TypeScript and Node.js toolkit for coding-agent repository readiness, context optimization, instruction validation, task workflows, policy checks, evidence and verification.
rules: For commands and options use docs/reference/cli.md and the latest supported npm package; never suggest commands absent from those sources.
Use docs/guides/feature-index.md to discover implemented features and link to canonical guides and references for details.
ACKit runtime is offline-first, deterministic and does not require hosted Context7/Docs7, telemetry, LLM APIs or network service calls.
State-bound verification must respect task acceptance criteria, fresh evidence, independent verification and stale/replay guards; do not bypass completion gates.
Treat historical ADRs, archived tasks and old release notes as history, not current product governance.
